recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit this source area only when later final/applied work such as FHIR-51651 or FHIR-54000 is in scope, or if the API Incubator GraphDefinition source needs separate external review.
issue_request: FHIR-40492 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to bind SearchParameter.base, SearchParameter.target, OperationDefinition.resource, and GraphDefinition.node.type to the inter-version resource value set from FHIR-38800, with version-specific additional bindings and documentation for cross-version use.
initial_application: Commit 9082a9058ae488744811761db09744036f308ffa applied the requested bindings. Follow-up commits 6ba28a62fc02ab39d84279e575608931a602f0a7, c8e676ed7029945ae371b876d2cf99ab688fd2a9, and 6491a8ae4e027cbc00f1cc6f7e436d3801f74574 normalized the binding strength, switched to version-independent-all-resource-types where abstract resources are allowed, registered the value set, and corrected the additional binding tag form.
additional_context: OperationDefinition and SearchParameter are active in source/fhir.ini, and both affected definitions use version-independent-all-resource-types with an all-resource-types UI additional binding documented as the R5 resource-type set. GraphDefinition was removed from core source by the R6 normative changes and the conformance module now points to the API Incubator. Later issues FHIR-51651 and FHIR-54000 affect the same area but are not Applied/Published in this run scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the in-build current source already implements the FHIR-40492 decision and the remaining originally named GraphDefinition element is outside current core build scope.
